name: Valkyrie
source:
fortissimo//Akkord:nächsten Phase Description

A mysterious woman who appears whenever [url=https://vndb.org/c14237]Reiji[/url] is in danger. Although she never reveals her true identity, this beautiful figure will always help him. Even when she comes face to face with the enemy, her graceful figure will never waver. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=776568]Getchu[/url]]

[spoiler]Kadenz fermata//Akkord:fortissimo Description

In combat, she plays a strategist role, while finding efficient ways to defend Reiji and fending off the enemy. Valkyrie is one of the "Mahoutsukai" who is belligerent, preferring to fight in battles for her own reasons.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=853984]Getchu[/url]][/spoiler]
